display_name: 全量 G10 源配对的完整轨迹恢复网络
description: 独立从零训练两条四步生成轨迹，使用原 63,000 条 L_s/U_s 的固定 G10/clean 配对；完整七景与 Phase3 truth-last 对照。

data.representation: Fixed full 63000 original source L_s/U_s G10 2.45 GHz MIX01 received and corresponding one-RMS clean; each physical ID appears once per epoch
data.actual_training_labels: No TX labels; frozen original source F0 feature guidance; no V/OE/novel/target IQ in G training.
data.augmentation: One fixed source observation per ID; 75% received/25% clean sampled per epoch; independent opposite training noise

permissions.regime: Source L_s/U_s training with frozen original supervised source F0 feature knowledge; no target adaptation or training on heldout source data
permissions.query_use: Independent frozen per-record prediction; no target U, selection, tuning or threshold fitting
permissions.claim_scope: Development RX34 fixed Phase3 G10 and historical F50 full seven-view tests; original Phase3 PCD has target-U576 ancestry and DURA-calibrated thresholds; no blind or new registration claim.

checkpoint.initialization: Scratch full-trajectory attention velocity field, no E20/E30 weights; frozen original source F0 as identity guide
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Full source G10 cache commit 53410ce889adc94c53c1783741f970fbdaf51453, role IDs equal original F0 contract; clean paired RMS once; PCD target-U ancestry downstream only
checkpoint.selection_rule: One fixed E30/14790 final checkpoint and two fixed antithetic inference paths; no model, path, or threshold selection from target results.

metric_names: historical F50 accuracy and raw-clean gap by scene, TX, RX and day
historical clean damage and paired DURA repairs/damages
Phase3 original-F0 same-ID per-scene raw-clean gap
fixed PCD A_K/C_K/R_U/H-score and paired DURA changes
matched latency, throughput, memory and 8 velocity-field calls
dimensions: source V and full 168000 historical target physical records x seven views
Phase3 source V/novel and same 10238 clean/star physical records
metrics_plan.targets_ref: Every six scenes raw-clean minus restored star F0 macro <=3pp; clean degradation <=1pp; Phase3 CK>=90%, clean RU>=95%, star RU>=90%, same-G closed-open loss<=2pp; registration independent.

rows.method: Scratch four-step two-path conditional Transformer trained through its actual paths on full G10 source pairs
rows.purpose: Source-only true-rollout training and mandatory same-system evaluation
rows.seed_notes: model 2026092701, source-order 2026110104, flow 2026110105, fixed antithetic output template 2026110103; original source split and fixed evaluation seeds retained
rows.scenario: All 6300 source L_s and 56700 source U_s, fixed G10 MIX01/clean; historical seven-view and Phase3 fixed-system evaluation

notes: Independent full-source G10 comparison was preregistered while the original mixed-source rollout was still training, before its target results. The user requested a route different from the other chat; only its authorized source cache is reused, not its time/frequency architecture or weights.

Validated source cache role/order matches frozen F0 exactly, with 6300 L_s and 56700 U_s. Independent 256-row role-stratified clean comparison max absolute difference 2.3841858e-7 against historical normalized source. Whole original dataset was unpickled in cache construction, but only L_s/U_s values indexed; this G training opens cache clean/received/IDs/roles, no TX/V/OE/target IQ.

All records use one fixed G10 MIX01 input repeatedly; no new physical observation is created by repeated epochs. Data differs from mixed-source arm both in full physical-record coverage and channel distribution; effects cannot be separately attributed.

Each source sample is used once per epoch, randomly assigned 75% G10 received or 25% clean. Full four-step opposite-noise paths receive mean paired IQ NMSE plus frozen F0 feature anchor plus 0.25 feature agreement. Same initialization, optimizer, noise scale, inference rule and 30-epoch budget as mixed-source rollout.

F0 retains supervised source knowledge; no labels fed to G. Fixed final E30/14790; full historical seven-view and Phase3 frozen predictions finish before any CPU scorer opens truth. No target-based selection or threshold fit.
Actual F0/G10 smoke required. 11 focused tests and independent P0/P1 review passed; role and clean comparison read-back verified. Batch128 GPU memory still needs actual run.
CPU controller waits for the previous rollout profile to complete; shared lock also accounts for known other Phase3 restoration workers before GPU admission, and no running jobs are modified.
